_note: Monster attack packages — the class-equivalent for non-sentient NPCs. 'packages' is keyed by race key (module/data/races/<key>.json); when a race has no entry, 'typeDefaults' by creatureType applies. Each attack names a natural-weapon template from module/data/weapons/templates/natural.json. Chart animals (wolf, bear) carry the RMSS Animal Statistics Chart decode: 'ob' is the chart OB TOTAL (the finalizer sets the weapon obMod to ob minus the rank bonus at chart level, so the engine total matches the chart at chart level and scales with wizard level through skill ranks); 'attackSize' is the attack-size letter from the chart notation (T/S/M/L/H); 'chance' is the trailing % chance the attack is used (Creatures & Treasures KEY: the %s sum to 100 over non-conditional attacks; an attack with no trailing code is optional at GM discretion — chance null). 'chartAttack' is the verbatim chart string for provenance. attackSize and chance are stored but not yet wired in the engine. Attacks with weapon:null (no template yet, e.g. grapple) are recorded but not granted.
